issues.claim: "A 2015 Applied Ergonomics field study of full-time CCTV surveillance operators (Donald, Donald & Thatcher)"
issues.problem: The only accessible source (ECU repository abstract) does not describe a field setting: participants were operators who "observed a 90-min video" and were required to detect four target behaviours, i.e. a controlled detection task performed by field-recruited operators. Calling it a "field study" overstates the design. The measured numbers themselves (50% detected, high false alarms, total N=73, stage-one 42 operators with no decrement) are stated verbatim in the abstract and are correct.
issues.fix: Re-describe as "a 2015 Applied Ergonomics study of 42/73 full-time CCTV operators using a 90-minute video detection task", or add "study setting not characterised in the open abstract" to data_gaps.

issues.claim: "the one field study of CCTV operators found they detected about half of target behaviours"
issues.problem: Uniqueness claim ("the one") is not supported by the cited abstract and is the kind of superlative the rest of the brief avoids.
issues.fix: Drop "the one" - use "the best-known study of CCTV operator detection rates".

issues.problem: The cited omniapartners/Bluum PDF will not parse ("Invalid PDF structure") and I could not open it. Only the $199/$549/$899 tiers are partially corroborated by search-result text from that PDF (a "LIC-CAM-1Y" table); the $1,799 (10-year) figure is corroborated by nothing I could reach. Quoting them is inconsistent with how the brief handled Hailo-8 and Dahua, where unverifiable prices were removed.
issues.fix: Delete the four figures and keep Verkada pricing as "Unknown - quote-based" only, as already stated in the same field and in data_gaps.

issues.claim: GoodTrack "describes ... a YOLOv8 + ByteTrack pipeline ... using a custom RetailGoods dataset"
issues.problem: The cited ScienceDirect URL returns HTTP 403 (I reproduced this), so the pipeline/model/dataset description cannot be verified from the cited page. It is consistent with search-result text returned for that URL, but it is presented as fact while data_gaps flags only the sample size and incident counts, not the description itself.
issues.fix: Either add the pipeline description to data_gaps as snippet-sourced, or state it as "search-snippet description of the paper (full text inaccessible)".

issues.claim: "Hailo-8 M.2 module (26 TOPS) - best detector throughput per watt in the Frigate table"
issues.problem: 26 TOPS is confirmed on the Hailo page, but Frigate's hardware table has no power/watt column, so "best throughput per watt" is an unlabelled inference rather than a documented figure.
issues.fix: Say "fastest measured detector in Frigate's table (YOLOv6n ~7 ms, ssd mobilenet ~6 ms)" or label the per-watt claim as an inference.

issues.claim: Pilot hardware block: "Estimated hardware total for a 6-camera pilot: roughly $1,200-$2,500"
issues.problem: The same paragraph lists a Jetson Orin Nano Super ($249) and a Home Assistant Green ($199) as optional additions. Including either pushes the total to about $2,749 and past the stated $2,500 ceiling; the range is arithmetic-consistent only if both optionals are excluded.
issues.fix: State the range as "~$1,200-$2,500 base, up to ~$2,750 with the optional Jetson and Green".

issues.problem: Arithmetic is correct (15+13+9+13+9+9 = 68; every sub-score inside its range) and the rationale discloses the reasoning, but 9/15 is 60% on a dimension named "legal_risk_low" while the legal section records criminal exposure (N.J.S.A. 2C:14-9), two unverified negative findings (NJ camera-notice, NJ biometric) and BIPA/FTC exposure. It reads generous relative to the evidence, even after the design mitigations.
issues.fix: Either publish the rubric anchor that makes 9/15 "moderate-low" on this dimension, or reduce to 7-8/15 (total 66-67).

issues.claim: Frigate "since 0.16 optional vision-language descriptions of tracked objects"
issues.problem: The version number is not on the cited Frigate+ FAQ page, nor on the GenAI configuration page I opened. It is corroborated only by a search-result summary pointing at docs.frigate.video/configuration/genai/genai_objects.
issues.fix: Cite the GenAI object-description docs page for the 0.16 claim, or drop the version number.
